tips.text: Run Phorid whenever an Infested Assassination node is up; a run takes about a minute against 16 or more Circuit stages for Systems.
Run Infested invasions for Fieldron, Detonite or Mutagen Mass; they often land on an Assassination node and drop Nyx parts by accident.
Run Phorid solo and walk to the high platform; the host triggers its spawn.
Keep moving and stay close to Phorid, and bring invisibility or extra health; Spine Strike homes, bypasses shields and can one-shot a low-health frame.
Finish before the outbreak ends; the run is lost if the node reverts mid-mission.
Expect Systems last; duplicate Neuroptics and Chassis are normal, and one player needed 20 runs for a single Systems.
Pick the Infested planet whose rare resource your build needs; Phorid drops it too.
Check the star chart again later instead of waiting for an outbreak.
Players call Nyx an easy farm with an outbreak up and an irritating wait without one.
